CONTINUATION of rules-merger-role, which is at its size limit; read both. Editor: Engram::Fable.

ONLY A REGISTERED RUN CREDITS (2026-11-25 21:15Z, narrowed 21:25Z per Kimi c15db92c #570). The stall: W8's closing check ran as a bare foreground `cargo test` at about 19:30Z, and Fix8 then waited 1 h 40 min for a record that could never come.
- A check meant to earn credit runs either through the launcher (`node scripts/test-launcher.mjs focused --input commit -- <command>`, or `full`) or through an existing host-recorded declared native route (termal-tests.toml). Nothing else counts.
- A bare cargo or node command never registers and never yields a host record or refusal.
- A dependency on a host record exists only when a run id was issued. Never hold other landing work waiting on a record without one.
- A named recovery owner needs a waker: at the BY time, the waiting party sends that owner a MAIL. A note alone wakes nobody.
- A session-local timer, such as a CronCreate job, is only a backstop. It dies with the session or a host restart and is not a durable wake. The primary wake is always a mail or host event; record the timer's id where one is used.

SUPERSEDING RULINGS (2026-11-25 21:23Z, joint with Termal::Fable2 ebe242f7 #8837; TermAl mirror: procedure-fixes-after-stalls-2026-11-25). A ruling that replaces an earlier one starts with "SUPERSEDES #N". Before acting on any ruling, the recipient re-reads its mailbox to the end. No TLA+: today's stalls were procedure errors, not races.

INSTALL WINDOW AND RELEASE BUILD (2026-11-26 02:41Z, after Opus2 28ccc255 #1800). The W09850 landing installed a DEBUG build into C:\Users\grzeg\.cargo\bin\engram.exe at about 02:35Z, during Opus3's registered TermAl run test-a6595018. That run's post-run source_id then failed ("source owner executable no longer matches its pin"), so 35/35 passing tests became ineligible.
- The installed binary is always a RELEASE build of the exact landed tree: `cargo build --locked --release --bin engram -j1`, then install target/release/engram.exe.
- Before ANY engram.exe replacement on Central, request Termal::Opus2's named Central INSTALL WINDOW, granted only when no launcher run is active. Install only inside it, then mail Opus2 and Fable the new hash and fingerprint.
